chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni:
Indeed, ʿAli عليه السلام used to hold the leader, the driver, and the rider liable.

key_terms.السَّائِقَ: the one driving the animal from behind
key_terms.يُضَمِّنُ: to hold legally liable or financially accountable

ai.seo_question: Who is held liable in Shia fiqh when an animal causes harm?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam ʿAli عليه السلام concerning liability in cases involving an animal. It indicates that the person leading, driving, or riding the animal could be held responsible, making it relevant to judicial rulings and the rights of others.
